description: Machine-readable performance budgets for release gates. Values are conservative and should be updated only with intentional benchmark evidence.

latency_ms.logs_first_page.p95.rationale: Dashboard audit log pagination must stay bounded and responsive at 100k events.

latency_ms.logs_second_page.p95.rationale: Cursor pagination should not regress after the first page.

latency_ms.violations_first_page.p95.rationale: Operators need violation pages quickly enough for live triage.

latency_ms.stats_warm.p95.rationale: Persisted stats index should keep warm dashboard stats sub-millisecond.

latency_ms.stats_cold.p95.rationale: Cold stats can scan or rebuild indexes, but should stay within the documented 1M-era budget.

latency_ms.logs_first_page.p95.rationale: Large local JSONL files must not degrade bounded log pagination.

latency_ms.logs_second_page.p95.rationale: Large local JSONL files must not degrade cursor pagination.

latency_ms.violations_first_page.p95.rationale: The violation index should keep first-page operator triage under 100 ms.

latency_ms.stats_warm.p95.rationale: Persisted stats index should keep warm dashboard stats sub-millisecond.

latency_ms.stats_cold.p95.rationale: Cold stats on 10M local JSONL should remain in the documented synthetic evidence range.
